findings.passage: “The process of electing public officials is the cornerstone of our political system. Voter ID requirements are common sense security-measures to ensure only qualified electors participate in our elections. Election integrity should not be caught in the crosshairs if a partisan State Supreme Court decides to legislate from the bench.”
findings.note: Statement in her own press release on the Assembly vote to send the photo ID constitutional amendment to voters. The release also says she voted to send the amendment to referendum.

findings.passage: “The non-partisan Legislative Audit Bureau, in their elections administration report, noted a sharp increase in the number of people using the loophole in the 2020 election,” Duchow said.
findings.note: Quoted by Star News Network (article dated 2023-10-22) at an Assembly Committee on Campaigns and Elections hearing on her bill to tighten indefinitely confined absentee voting. The article also reports she said the law allows people to vote without showing an ID.

findings.passage: “In the November 2020 election alone, the Audit Bureau found that up to 48,544 individuals never showed a photo ID.”
findings.note: Same hearing, quoted by Star News Network. She cites an audit count of absentee voters who did not show a photo ID.
